answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. An agent locks a 300-credit bond and builds a record, like a juniper adding rings, from tasks and counterparties over 20 epochs. The bond unlocks only while the record stays consistent, so nobody can forge a history overnight. 100 fakes cost 30,000 credits locked, rewards frozen until maturity. A whisper of deviation freezes escrow for review. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
